profile.reading: This OpenStreetMap point in Porto San Giorgio, on Italy's Adriatic coast, tagged telecom=data_center, is named Studio BETA SRLS. "SRLS" is the Italian legal designation for a simplified limited-liability company, a structure commonly used by small startups, freelancers, and professional practices due to its lower minimum capital requirements, and "Studio" again indicates a professional-services or design practice in Italian usage. As with the similarly named Studio Delta Srl record elsewhere in this dataset, this pattern points to a small office rather than a data-center business. This entry documents the likely mistag rather than fabricating data-center specifications for what is, by its own name, a small professional-services firm.

reading.body:
A single OpenStreetMap point in Porto San Giorgio, Italy, tagged as a data center, is almost certainly a small professional-services office, not a data center.

The record carries no power figure, no operator, and no website. Its name, Studio BETA SRLS, uses the Italian word for a professional practice and the SRLS suffix, a simplified limited-liability form used by small firms and freelancers. The dataset's own note reads the name as evidence of a mistag rather than a facility.

For AI infrastructure, the useful signal is negative. A grid-constrained buildout depends on knowing which sites actually draw power, and a point with zero megawatts and no operator cannot be counted as capacity. Treating it as a data center would inflate the map by one node with no load behind it.

What this does not tell you is how many similar mistags exist. It is one record, reviewed once, with no count of the wider tagging error rate and no verification on the ground.
